Thought in dialogue

Essays by Alessandro Gentili

Essay 15 · Il mondo senza apprendisti (in Italian)

Direct reference. In section 7, Gentili invokes Aristotle’s builder. A first draft, feedback from someone with experience, and another attempt show how an apprentice develops judgment. The essay follows what happens to this practice when part of the work passes to artificial intelligence.

Essay 18 · Il futuro che sapevamo (in Italian)

Interpretive connection. In the guide, Aristotle invites readers to judge the city by the good it pursues. In «Il futuro non vota», Gentili asks who can represent the people who will bear the future costs of decisions made today. Reading the passages together raises the question of who is included in the common good.

Related triad

Triad III · Time, form, disenchantment (in Italian)

Seneca asks how we use time, Aristotle what form a life can take, and Weber how means become rationalized. The triad brings the three perspectives together around a question: what form can we give the time we have?
